question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's firm grip on the Chinese Communist Party and its military apparatus underpins the 95.7% trader consensus against his removal before 2027. Term limits were eliminated years ago, and recent personnel decisions—including extensive military purges—have further centralized authority in his hands without evident factional pushback ahead of the 21st Party Congress. No successor has been elevated to the Politburo Standing Committee, consistent with expectations that Xi will secure a fourth term. While a sudden health crisis or major external shock could still shift dynamics within the narrow window, current elite alignment and institutional controls make such outcomes improbable in the near term.
